Their default product interaction is active work according to each surface purpose and the selected object lifecycle: modeling/authoring for Enterprise, Scenarios and Labs; operational control for Runs; historical analysis/replay/AAR/compare for Results. Nodes, relations, phases, events, tasks, runtime objects, replay cursors and analytical selections remain directly interactive whenever the domain state, provider truth and command authority permit. Published Enterprise/Twin/Scenario/Lab revisions, Baselines, immutable Run Manifests and sealed Result/Event facts must be changed only through clone/new/superseding revision or the authorized lifecycle action; this must not be implemented by converting the owning workspace into a global read-only mode. decision: For the long-lived CEP Writer GitHub repository, `main` is the Controller-bound Writer baseline branch, not a free Writer worktree and not automatic CEP acceptance authority. Every mutating Writer mission must start from an exact Controller-bound `main` commit and work on one mission-specific candidate branch. Writers may commit/push only to that bound candidate branch and must never push directly to `main`, merge to `main`, create a release, self-promote, or mutate live Controller governance. Product changes belong only to genuine Product paths. `cep-writer/` remains Controller-owned read-only task authority. Small textual Writer handoff/evidence may be written under the mission's bounded `writer-output/<mission>/` path; heavy ZIPs/screenshots/baselines are not committed unless a mission explicitly requires them. decision: The long-lived CEP GitHub Writer repository is the self-contained execution-input plane for ALL CEP Writer types and equivalent mission Auditors/Reviewers. Before every mission, the Controller—not the worker—must resolve live CEP authority and compile a minimum-sufficient CLOSED/MANDATORY READ SET: exact repository/source/test/reference/profile/oracle/Owner-decision paths (or exact sections/symbols where full-file reading is unnecessary), each input's purpose/read mode, exact writable/read-only/prohibited scope, and explicit DO_NOT_READ / NO_DISCOVERY_BY_DEFAULT boundaries. Broad repository archaeology, repo-wide recursive search, generic grep/rg/find, or instructions such as 'inspect anything useful' are prohibited by default because they waste model context and can import stale/unrelated authority. A BOUNDED_DISCOVERY_ESCAPE is allowed only for a named missing, contradictory, or insufficient mission input and must stay within the smallest relevant directory/source family and record why it was needed. `main` must carry the current Controller-bound Product baseline plus every reusable/current Writer-readable input a competent worker needs: build/test tooling, contracts/profiles, current governed visual references, applicable domain/oracle/technical references, Writer-relevant Owner-decision snapshots, protected-truth/acceptance rules, workflow guidance, and genuinely required deterministic fixtures/reference datasets. A mission branch/workspace inherits those inputs and adds only the exact immutable mission overlay plus task-specific inputs not already present. Required reference images/PDFs/fixtures are INPUTS and remain available even when relatively large; do not remove them merely to minimize repository size. Writer execution must not depend on live Google Drive lookup for required task inputs. The Controller must retrieve/resolve any Drive-only authority/evidence/profile/oracle input before launch and embed or deterministically project the sufficient authoritative content into the repository, mission overlay, capsule, or bound workspace with provenance/hash/classification. CHATGPT_WRITER may possess a Drive connector, but required mission inputs are still pre-resolved and self-contained; live Drive is for Controller authority reconstruction, bounded explicitly-authorized retrieval, and output custody—not worker-side broad archaeology. GOOGLE_AI_STUDIO_WRITER and ROUTE-LOCAL workers must not be instructed to read required inputs directly from Drive. ROUTE-LOCAL additionally uses the already materialized governed local repository/worktree as its execution source: do not clone/pull/fetch from GitHub at the start of every mission. Bind the exact local repository path/branch/HEAD/tree and continue from it; clone/fetch/pull occurs only when the Owner/Controller explicitly authorizes a transport synchronization because the required checkpoint is absent/stale or a carrier transition requires it. Google Drive remains canonical for live Controller state/governance and heavy GENERATED OUTPUT custody such as candidate/evidence/baseline ZIPs, large screenshot sets, videos and generated reports. Small handoff/results/receipts may bind external Drive outputs by file ID, SHA-256, bytes and source/commit identity. Before launch, Controller must prove MISSION REQUIRED INPUT SET -> EXACT PATH/SECTION RESOLUTION -> HASH/CLASSIFICATION MATCH -> CONTEXT-SUFFICIENT CLOSED READ SET -> NO REQUIRED DRIVE-ONLY DEPENDENCY -> WRITER_SELF_CONTAINMENT_PASS. If any required input is missing/stale/unresolved, launch stops as WRITER_INPUT_INCOMPLETE.
notes: Owner explicitly required the former local-only prompt/read-set extension to be merged into this same durable decision instead of remaining a separate active OD. OD-20260925-084 is preserved only as superseded lineage. The generalized law applies to all Writer types; route-specific facts remain scoped: Local and Google AI Studio do not directly consume required Drive inputs, and Local normally continues from its existing governed local repository rather than cloning/pulling every mission.

decision: For CEP Writer/Controller visual work, browser/network/localhost navigation failure must be treated separately from browser launch, rendering, JavaScript/DOM execution, pointer/keyboard interaction, screenshot creation/inspection, video capture/validation, and genuine route/platform proof. A Writer must use the bounded local/offline recovery ladder in `WRITER_LOCAL_VISUAL_CAPTURE_AND_RENDERING_METHOD.md` before declaring visual capture blocked. Navigation-independent real-browser rendering from exact candidate bytes via `page.set_content()` or an equivalent in-memory path is valid fresh Presentation/interaction evidence when explicitly classified `NOT_GENUINE_ROUTE`; it does not prove HTTP routing, Back/Forward, network, or platform integration. Missing bundled browser/FFmpeg tooling may be satisfied by already-installed validated binaries or governed offline packages using temporary execution-only paths, without Product architecture/dependency mutation. Every material screenshot must be actually opened and visually inspected; material video must be structurally validated and representative states/transitions inspected where applicable. Localhost/browser route restriction alone is not a reason to stop screenshots/video or ask the Owner to capture them manually when another truthful local rendering path works.

decision: For CEP Writers, especially CHATGPT_WRITER, the primary work loop is local execution and iterative Product improvement, not external evidence transport. Intermediate screenshots, crops, visual diffs, videos, logs, build outputs and comparison artifacts are execution scratch and remain local/ephemeral by default. Their first purpose is to help the Writer discover defects, compare current Product state against the governed reference component-by-component/state-by-state, implement the narrowest correct change, then rerender/recapture/reinspect until the result is clean. Only the final representative source-bound captures/results that materially support handoff/audit are promoted to durable evidence. The GitHub connector MUST NOT be used as a bulk-file, screenshot/video, per-file blob-assembly or general evidence-transfer channel when local execution plus bounded final custody suffices. GitHub carries Product source/delta, mission-bound authority inputs, and small receipts/handoffs; ChatGPT heavy generated outputs and candidate/evidence bundles go to Google Drive in one bounded final custody step when needed. Google AI Studio may use its governed candidate-branch evidence exception only because Drive output is unavailable there, and still should avoid intermediate evidence churn. Connector/tool limits are transport constraints, never a reason to spend the Writer's main effort on packaging, split uploads or repeated custody operations, and never a reason to change Product architecture. Prefer reference decomposition/cropping -> current capture -> region/state comparison -> diagnose -> fix -> recapture -> compare -> repeat, with final evidence promotion only after the Writer has used the loop to improve the Product.
notes: Owner explicitly rejected time spent on connector/file-transfer mechanics and clarified that Writer screenshots/evidence primarily exist to drive the Writer's own correction loop. This clarifies and tightens OD-067, OD-068 and OD-072 without changing Product authority, branch lineage or acceptance requirements.

decision: For CEP CHATGPT_WRITER missions governed by the Workspace Capsule method, capsule preparation is a Controller responsibility, not a Writer setup task. Before handoff the Controller binds and packages the exact adjudicated source/branch, complete mission-bound authority/reference inputs, the applicable reusable harness/capture method, and—when Presentation/interaction comparison is material and technically available—a bounded source-bound Visual Bootstrap Pack containing initial current-parent screenshots, capture/raw receipts, viewport/state metadata, reference bindings and comparison-plan metadata. The Writer's normal first duty is download once -> verify -> materialize -> inspect the prebuilt baseline/reference mapping -> compare -> diagnose -> fix -> recapture locally -> compare again. Bootstrap screenshots are acceleration inputs only and never final acceptance evidence. If a needed state is missing/partial or bootstrap capture is unavailable, the Writer may use the packaged harness/method to recapture locally without rebuilding the capsule or using connector-driven per-file setup. Visual bootstrap generation must never use stale/unbound screenshots, fabricate PASS, widen mutation authority, or make Product architecture depend on transport/capture constraints.
notes: Owner explicitly clarified that the Controller should prepare the improved capsule and its harness/bootstrap materials before Writer launch so Writers receive a ready-to-work artifact and spend their time on comparison/correction. This extends OD-074 and preserves OD-073 evidence-locality. Infrastructure implementation remains isolated on controller/writer-workspace-capsule-v1.

decision: For CEP Writer correction/repair continuations after a Writer has produced a source-bound candidate that the Controller has independently reconstructed/audited and explicitly retained as a salvageable correction base, the default continuation path is VERIFIED_INCREMENTAL_CONTINUATION rather than automatically rebuilding a full Writer Workspace Capsule. The Controller must bind the exact continuation parent HEAD/tree/Product-source identity, open findings, preserved closures, writable/read-only/prohibited scope, architecture/owner locks, required falsification/regression/evidence, output custody and Stop Gate in a lightweight continuation overlay. Continuation path order is: (A) the same Writer may continue directly from an existing worktree only after exact HEAD/tree/Product-source/clean-status verification; (B) a new Writer or lost/untrusted worktree reconstructs the exact candidate from the nearest already-verified Capsule/base plus the exact ordered candidate-delta/git-bundle chain, verifying every prerequisite, hash, ancestry and resulting identity; (C) a new full Capsule is built only when A/B are impossible or unsafe, reconstruction lineage is ambiguous/missing/materially cumbersome, required mission inputs/harness/reference bytes materially changed beyond safe overlay reuse, or fresh isolation materially improves correctness. Previous Writer candidates and evidence remain immutable lineage and are never overwritten; each correction produces a new successor candidate/handoff. A candidate used as a correction parent remains CANDIDATE_ONLY and gains no acceptance/promotion authority. Never use sibling-ZIP overlay or manual changed-file overlay to reconstruct lineage. This law applies across CEP phases and Writer correction loops; a genuinely new mission/lane still defaults to the full Capsule method unless Controller proves verified continuation is the safer exact path.
notes: Owner explicitly generalized the B3-R Correction03 efficiency lesson to all CEP stages: correction loops should continue from the exact latest Writer result when safely verifiable/reconstructable instead of repeatedly rebuilding full capsules. Full Capsule remains the initialization/fallback path, not a mandatory wrapper for every correction.

decision: For the current one-persistent-Writer serial operating mode, CEP uses one stable long-lived non-main Writer candidate branch `writer/cep-serial`, created from the exact Controller-bound `main`. The single persistent Writer executes mutating Missions strictly serially on that branch. Every Mission begins from an explicitly bound exact audited checkpoint, ends at one exact bounded commit plus STOP gate, and receives independent Controller audit/adjudication before the next Mission may start. An unadjudicated Mission delta must never be carried silently into the next Mission. If a checkpoint is rejected or needs bounded correction, correction remains on the same serial branch and within that Mission until the Controller retains an exact successor checkpoint. The Writer must never push directly to `main`, merge to `main`, self-accept, self-promote, release, deploy, or mutate live Controller governance. If CEP returns to multiple parallel Writers, mission-specific candidate branches again become the default unless the Owner explicitly decides otherwise. This decision supersedes only the mission-specific-branch-per-mutating-Mission clause of OD-20260921-066 while the current one-persistent-Writer serial mode is active; every other OD-20260921-066 protection remains active.
notes: Owner explicitly changed the current execution topology from parallel mission-specific Writer branches to one persistent Writer executing Missions serially on one long-lived candidate branch. Commit/checkpoint isolation replaces branch-per-Mission isolation; scope, owner locks, evidence, audit, and acceptance protections remain unchanged.

ChatGPT and Google AI Studio remain under general Writer law, exact Mission/DAG collision/dependency binding, OD-20260916-043 value-weighted parallelism, and OD-20260921-066 mission-bound candidate branches by default unless a newer carrier-specific decision says otherwise. decision: For ROUTE-LOCAL, the Owner controls task grouping, continuation boundaries, and when Controller audit/STOP is required. The Controller must not invent a mandatory audit/permission gate between every local task merely because tasks have separate mission labels. When the Owner explicitly groups or sequences local tasks for continuous execution, the persistent local Writer may continue on the exact same governed lineage through those task boundaries, preserving exact scope, checkpoints/receipts, collision locks and truth ceilings, until the Owner-defined audit/stop boundary. decision: For ROUTE-LOCAL, every Controller-issued mission/prompt for a local Writer, Auditor, Reviewer, or similar execution worker must be pre-resolved by the Controller so the worker receives the minimum sufficient mission context without broad archaeology. Before launch, the Controller must determine from live CEP authority plus the exact local/GitHub repository state what that worker actually needs, then bind an explicit CLOSED/MANDATORY READ SET with exact local paths and purpose, distinguishing READ_WHOLE_FILE from READ_ONLY_SECTIONS_OR_SYMBOLS where useful; exact source/test/reference/profile/oracle/Owner-decision inputs; exact writable/read-only/prohibited paths; and explicit DO_NOT_READ / NO_DISCOVERY_BY_DEFAULT boundaries. Repo-wide recursive search, broad grep/rg/find, generic governance archaeology, or 'inspect anything useful' instructions are prohibited by default because they waste context and can import unrelated/stale authority. A BOUNDED_DISCOVERY_ESCAPE may be allowed only when a named path/symbol is missing, contradictory, or insufficient for the exact mission; it must be narrowly scoped to the smallest relevant directory/source family, record why it was needed, and stop on material authority/lineage contradiction. If mission-required authority, evidence, oracle/profile content, Owner-decision meaning, or other required input exists in Google Drive but is not already available in the local repository/workspace, the Controller—not the local worker—must retrieve and resolve it before launch and make the mission self-contained by embedding the sufficient authoritative content directly in the prompt/mission overlay or by providing an exact deterministic local projection with provenance/hash/classification. Local workers must not depend on live Drive lookups or be told to search Drive for required inputs. If a required input cannot be safely embedded or projected, launch is blocked until the Controller provides a bounded consumable form. This law applies to mutation Writers and read-only Auditors/Reviewers alike; read-only missions may receive broader read scope only when the mission itself requires it, and that breadth must still be explicitly bounded and relevant.
notes: Owner explicitly directed that this extension not remain a separate active decision. Its durable exact-read-set/context-efficiency/self-containment value is merged in place into OD-20260921-067 for all Writer types, with Local/Google-AI-Studio route-specific clauses retained there.
